hosea.1.p1.b1.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri … of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.

hosea.1.p1.b2.text: Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.

hosea.1.p1.b3.text: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim

hosea.1.p2.b1.text: Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu …

hosea.1.p2.b2.text: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”

hosea.1.p2.b3.text: Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.

hosea.1.p2.b4.text: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them … by the LORD their God.

hosea.1.p3.b1.text: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.

hosea.1.p3.b2.text: Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.

hosea.1.p3.b3.text: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. … they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

hosea.1.p3.b4.text: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
